body: Spec hypothesis 'obstacle at the crossing (curb/prop/lamp/seam)' rejected: props have no colliders, headless seed-1 run on the exact QA path passes both stall points at run speed, runtime stall shows MoveIntent.axis == 0 (input lost), not a blocked capsule.

Fixed the root cause in the QA harness (tools/qa/brp.py send_keys refuses a re-press of a key whose earlier hold has not ended) instead of game code; alternative was cancelling bevy_brp_extras TimedKeyRelease entities over BRP, impossible because the component is not reflected.

send_keys failure handling split by cause: JSON-RPC error reply (RuntimeError) reserves nothing so a retry passes; transport failure marks the key math.inf (blocked for the session) because the press may land with an uncancellable release timer. Alternative rejected: review's literal 'reserve only after a confirmed press', which lets a retry overlap a timed-out press.
